blocks.content:
The Vice President is the second-highest constitutional office in India.
Key Facts:
• Ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha
• Acts as President in absence of President
The Vice President is the second-highest constitutional office in India.

items: Articles 63–71 specifically deal with the Vice President of India.
The Vice President serves as the Ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
The Vice President steps in to act as President during the President's absence.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Vice President holds the second-highest constitutional office in India.
The position is governed by Articles 63–71 of the Constitution.
Serves as the Ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
Acts as President in the absence of the President.
